page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with two parallel columns of Latin verb forms (Italian-style conjugation list, left column Latin forms, right column Latin translations); headings in small caps between sections; running head at top; catchword/signature at bottom right ("cQ" mark). No marginal notes.

main_text.head: Præt.imperfect.
main_text.l: Io Hauéßi | V tinam ego haberem.
main_text.head: Idem aliter.
main_text.p: Io Hauerèi, Haurèi, & Harrèi, O Ego haberem.
tu hauerésti, hauréßi, & Harréßi tu haberes.
colúi Hauerébbe, Haurébbe, & Harrébbe ille haberet.
Nói Hauerémmo, Haurémmo, & Harrémmo Nos haberemus.
vói Hauerèste, Hauréste, & Harréste vos haberetis.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the Italian-style forms in the left column and the second-person forms are partly blurred; "ille" in the fourth-from-last line and the final "Harréste" may carry misprints. Right-hand column rendered as lines with " | " separators; the printed layout places the translations flush right. Catchword and marginal marks at lower right ("cQ") read as a signature; uncertain.
